assignedReviews.reason: The card does not identify a science invention from home or the local community, nor does it explain any impact on everyday life. It only gives the origin of the name 'Velcro', which is unrelated to the competency's requirement.

copy.en:
Why is it called 'Velcro'?

The name comes from two French words: 'velours' which means velvet, and 'crochet' which means hook!
copy.tl:
Bakit ito tinatawag na 'Velcro'?

Galing ang pangalan sa dalawang salitang Pranses: 'velours' na ibig sabihin ay pelus, at 'crochet' na ibig sabihin ay kawit!
copy.bis:
Nganong gitawag kining 'Velcro'?

Ang ngalan gikan sa duha ka Pranses nga pulong: 'velours' nga buot pasabot velvet, ug 'crochet' nga buot pasabot kaw-it!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When metals are heated, their atoms and free electrons vibrate faster, which causes heat and electricity to transfer through the metal more quickly.

copy.en: When metals are heated, their atoms and free electrons vibrate faster, which causes heat and electricity to transfer through the metal more quickly.
copy.tl: Kapag naiinitan ang mga metal, mas mabilis na nag-vibrate ang kanilang mga atom at free electrons, na nagiging dahilan upang mas mabilis na lumipat ang init at kuryente sa metal.
copy.bis: Kung mainitan ang mga metal, mas paspas nga mag-vibrate ang ilang mga atom ug free electrons, nga maoy hinungdan nga mas paspas nga mobalhin ang init ug kuryente sa metal.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about vinegar/acetic acid as a chemical compound; it provides no information about muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory body systems.

copy.en: Vinegar is a compound called acetic acid, with the chemical formula CH3COOH, made of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen atoms.
copy.tl: Ang suka ay isang compound na tinatawag na acetic acid, na may chemical formula na CH3COOH, gawa sa carbon, hydrogen, at oxygen atoms.
copy.bis: Ang suka usa ka compound nga gitawag og acetic acid, nga adunay chemical formula nga CH3COOH, gihimo sa carbon, hydrogen, ug oxygen atoms.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: a virus first attaches to a cell's surface
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use proper techniques in observing and identifying the parts of a cell with a microscope such as the cell membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, mitochondria, and chloroplasts
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes how a virus attaches to a cell before entering. G7-L-2 requires using proper microscope techniques to observe and identify cell parts such as the cell membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, mitochondria, and chloroplasts. The card does not address microscope use, cell parts, or identification techniques, and is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
How does a virus get inside a cell?

Before entering, a virus first attaches to a cell's surface, fitting like a key into a matching lock.
copy.tl:
Paano pumapasok ang virus sa selula?

Bago pumasok, kumakapit muna ang virus sa ibabaw ng selula, parang susi na tumutugma sa kandado.
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagsulod sa virus sa selula?

Sa dili pa mosulod, mokapyot una ang virus sa ibabaw sa selula, sama sa yawi nga mohaom sa kandado.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In 2020, COVID-19 spread so fast worldwide it was called a pandemic
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use a table to show how living things can be classified into groups based on similar characteristics (plants including flowering and non-flowering; animals including mammals, reptiles, insects, birds, fish, amphibians; microorganisms including fungi and bacteria)

copy.tl: Noong 2020, mabilis na kumalat ang COVID-19 sa buong mundo kaya tinawag itong pandemya -- sa Pilipinas, nagsara ang mga eskwela at trabaho at lumipat sa online classes upang pigilan ang paghawa.
copy.bis: Niadtong 2020, paspas nga mikaylap ang COVID-19 sa tibuok kalibutan mao nga gitawag kining pandemya -- sa Pilipinas, nagsira ang mga eskwelahan ug trabaho ug nibalhin sa online classes aron mapugngan ang pagkatap.

copy.en: The Hepatitis B virus attacks the liver and can cause long-term illness — good thing a vaccine is already given to children!
copy.tl: Ang Hepatitis B virus ay umaatake sa atay at maaaring magdulot ng pangmatagalang sakit — mabuti na lang may bakuna nang ibinibigay sa mga bata!
copy.bis: Ang Hepatitis B virus moatake sa atay ug mahimong hinungdan sa tag-as nga sakit — maayo na lang naay bakuna nga gihatag sa mga bata!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In the lytic cycle, a virus sneaks into a cell, hijacks its machinery to copy itself again and again, then bursts the cell open to release new viruses.

copy.en: In the lytic cycle, a virus sneaks into a cell, hijacks its machinery to copy itself again and again, then bursts the cell open to release new viruses.
copy.tl: Sa lytic cycle, sumasama ang virus sa loob ng selula, ginagamit ang makinarya nito para gumawa ng maraming kopya ng sarili, at pagkatapos ay sinisira ang selula para makalabas.
copy.bis: Sa lytic cycle, mosulod ang virus sa selula, gamiton ang makinarya niini aron makahimo og daghang kopya sa kaugalingon, ug dayon mabuto ang selula aron makagawas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Visible light is the only part of the electromagnetic spectrum that our eyes can see
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how earthquakes result in tsunamis that devastate shoreline communities
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses visible light and sight, which is unrelated to earthquakes causing tsunamis. No content supports the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Visible light is the only part of the electromagnetic spectrum that our eyes can see
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: make models of fault scenarios to illustrate: a. the epicenter of an earthquake from its focus, b. the intensity of an earthquake from its magnitude, and c. how underwater earthquakes may or may not generate tsunamis
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses visible light and sight, which is unrelated to fault models, epicenters, or tsunamis. No content supports the competency.

copy.en: Visible light is the only part of the electromagnetic spectrum that our eyes can see, enabling us to see things around us and giving light to the screens of most electronic devices.
copy.tl: Ang visible light ay ang tanging bahagi ng electromagnetic spectrum na nakikita ng ating mga mata, kaya nakikita natin ang mga bagay sa paligid at nagbibigay liwanag sa mga screen ng karamihan sa electronic devices.
copy.bis: Ang visible light mao lamang ang parte sa electromagnetic spectrum nga makita sa atong mga mata, busa makakita kita sa mga butang sa atong palibut ug mohatag sa kahayag sa mga screen sa kadaghanan sa electronic devices.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: 3% mass-by-volume ascorbic acid
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches how to interpret a mass-by-volume percentage in a liquid drink (solution concentration). G3-M-5 requires describing physical properties of solid materials such as hard, shiny, or stretchable. There is no solid material or physical property described; the content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
If a juice drink says 3% mass-by-volume ascorbic acid, how much Vitamin C do you get?

In a 100 ml drink, you get 3 grams of ascorbic acid, which is another name for Vitamin C!
copy.tl:
Kung ang isang juice drink ay nagsasabing 3% mass-by-volume ascorbic acid, gaano karaming Vitamin C ang makukuha mo?

Sa isang 100 ml na inumin, makakakuha ka ng 3 gramo ng ascorbic acid, na isa pang pangalan para sa Vitamin C!
copy.bis:
Kung ang usa ka juice drink nag-ingon ug 3% mass-by-volume ascorbic acid, pila ka Vitamin C ang imong makuha?

Sa usa ka 100 ml nga ilimnon, makakuha ka ug 3 gramos nga ascorbic acid, nga laing pangalan alang sa Vitamin C!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Viviparous animals can focus care and nourishment on one or few young
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes an advantage of viviparous animals (reproduction/biology), which has no relation to the competency about uniform and non-uniform mixtures such as solutions and suspensions. The subject matter is entirely different.

copy.en: Viviparous animals can focus care and nourishment on one or few young, giving each baby a better chance to survive.
copy.tl: Ang mga viviparous na hayop ay nakakapagtuon ng pangangalaga at pagkain sa isa o ilang anak, na nagbibigay sa bawat sanggol ng mas magandang pagkakataon na mabuhay.
copy.bis: Ang mga viviparous nga mananap makapunting sa pag-atiman ug pagkaon sa usa o pipila ka mga anak, nga naghatag sa matag anak ug mas maayong kahigayonan nga mabuhi.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Volatility is the tendency of a liquid to evaporate or turn into gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses volatility and evaporation of liquids, which is a physical/chemical property. G5-L-7 is about specialized structures in plants (rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, aerial roots). There is no plant content or specialized structure mentioned, so the card does not support this competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Volatility is the tendency of a liquid to evaporate or turn into gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how some plants have adapted to unfavorable conditions in the environment, such as lack of rain or floods
assignedReviews.reason: G5-L-8 is about plant adaptations to unfavorable conditions such as lack of rain or floods. The card is about volatility of liquids and acetone vs water, with no reference to plants or environmental adaptation. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Volatility is the tendency of a liquid to evaporate or turn into gas, and acetone is more volatile than water because it dries up much faster.
copy.tl: Ang volatility ay ang tendensya ng isang liquid na mag-evaporate o maging gas, at ang acetone ay mas volatile kaysa tubig dahil mas mabilis itong matuyo.
copy.bis: Ang volatility mao ang tendensya sa usa ka liquid nga mo-evaporate o mahimong gas, ug ang acetone mas volatile kay sa tubig tungod kay mas paspas kini mouga.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A volcanic arc is a chain of volcanoes that forms on the land above a subducting oceanic plate
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: make models of fault scenarios to illustrate: a. the epicenter of an earthquake from its focus, b. the intensity of an earthquake from its magnitude, and c. how underwater earthquakes may or may not generate tsunamis
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes volcanic arcs formed by subduction, which is unrelated to the competency about making models of fault scenarios to illustrate epicenter, intensity, and tsunamis. The card does not address faults, earthquakes, or tsunamis.

copy.en: A volcanic arc is a chain of volcanoes that forms on the land above a subducting oceanic plate, arranged in a curved line parallel to the trench.
copy.tl: Ang volcanic arc ay isang hanay ng mga bulkan na nabubuo sa lupa sa itaas ng lumulubog na oceanic plate, na nakaayos sa isang kurbadong linya na kahanay ng trench.
copy.bis: Ang volcanic arc usa ka laray sa mga bulkan nga maporma sa yuta sa taas sa naglubog nga oceanic plate, nga gihan-ay sa usa ka kurbadong linya nga parehas sa trench.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Volcanic eruptions can send out lava flows, ash clouds, and hot gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes volcanic hazards, which is unrelated to the competency about describing the general structure of the solar system and its celestial objects. The assigned code is a clear mismatch.

copy.en: Volcanic eruptions can send out lava flows, ash clouds, and hot gas that bury homes, damage crops, and make the air dangerous to breathe.
copy.tl: Ang pagsabog ng bulkan ay maaaring maglabas ng lava flows, ulap ng abo, at mainit na gas na tumatabon sa mga bahay, sumisira sa pananim, at nagpapadelikado sa hanging nilalanghap.
copy.bis: Ang pagbuto sa bulkan makapagawas ug lava flows, panganod sa abo, ug init nga gas nga magtabon sa mga balay, makadaot sa mga tanom, ug makapahimo sa hangin nga delikado nga masuyop.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Prepare a survival kit before a volcanic eruption with the same essentials as an earthquake kit: first aid, food, water, clothing, radio, flashlight, and batteries.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in temperature cause matter to change in state, such as solid to liquid to gas
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about assembling an emergency survival kit for a volcanic eruption. It contains no information about changes in temperature causing matter to change state (solid to liquid to gas). The topic is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Prepare a survival kit before a volcanic eruption with the same essentials as an earthquake kit: first aid, food, water, clothing, radio, flashlight, and batteries.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not describe changes of state (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation) or use diagrams/flowcharts. It is about emergency preparedness, not matter changes.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Prepare a survival kit before a volcanic eruption with the same essentials as an earthquake kit: first aid, food, water, clothing, radio, flashlight, and batteries.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of heat energy in change of state processes
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not explain the role of heat energy in change of state processes. It is about survival kit contents, not heat energy or phase changes.

copy.en: Prepare a survival kit before a volcanic eruption with the same essentials as an earthquake kit: first aid, food, water, clothing, radio, flashlight, and batteries.
copy.tl: Maghanda ng survival kit bago pumutok ang bulkan na may parehong mga kailangan tulad ng earthquake kit: first aid, pagkain, tubig, damit, radyo, flashlight, at baterya.
copy.bis: Pag-andam og survival kit sa dili pa mobuto ang bulkan nga adunay parehas nga mga kinahanglanon sama sa earthquake kit: first aid, pagkaon, tubig, sinina, radyo, flashlight, ug baterya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Higher voltage produces higher current because a stronger electrical pressure pushes more charges through the circuit.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to identify ways to reduce the impact of collisions such as seatbelts, airbags, and crumple zones in vehicles
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the relationship between voltage and current in a circuit. G10-F-7 is about reducing collision impact using seatbelts, airbags, and crumple zones. No instructional support for that competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Higher voltage produces higher current because a stronger electrical pressure pushes more charges through the circuit.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify inertia as the tendency for an object to stay at rest or in motion unless acted on by an unbalanced net force
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses electrical pressure and current, not inertia or the tendency of objects to stay at rest or in motion unless acted on by an unbalanced net force. Unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Higher voltage produces higher current because a stronger electrical pressure pushes more charges through the circuit.
copy.tl: Ang mas mataas na voltage ay nagbubunga ng mas mataas na current dahil mas malakas na electrical pressure ang nagtutulak ng mas maraming charges sa circuit.
copy.bis: Ang mas taas nga voltage mopatungha og mas taas nga current tungod kay mas kusog nga electrical pressure ang nagtulod sa mas daghang charges sa circuit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Voltage is calculated as work divided by charge
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the physics formula for voltage (V = W/q). G5-L-7 is about specialized structures in plants (rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, aerial roots). There is no connection to plant structures or any living-things content.

copy.en: Voltage is calculated as work divided by charge, written as V = W/q, where W is work in joules and q is charge in coulombs.
copy.tl: Ang voltage ay kinukwenta bilang trabaho na hinati sa charge, isinusulat bilang V = W/q, kung saan ang W ay trabaho sa joules at ang q ay charge sa coulombs.
copy.bis: Ang voltage gikalkulo isip trabaho nga gibahin sa charge, gisulat isip V = W/q, diin ang W kay trabaho sa joules ug ang q kay charge sa coulombs.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the volume percent is 45 percent
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the formation of ions as either the loss or gain of electrons to produce ionic bonds, using examples, such as the formation of sodium chloride
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches volume percent concentration calculation, which is unrelated to the competency about ion formation via electron loss/gain and ionic bonds (e.g., sodium chloride).

copy.en: If 81 milliliters of ethanol is added to make 180 milliliters of solution, the volume percent is 45 percent.
copy.tl: Kung 81 milliliters ng ethanol ang idinagdag para makabuo ng 180 milliliters ng solution, ang volume percent ay 45 percent.
copy.bis: Kon 81 milliliters nga ethanol ang idugang aron makahimo ug 180 milliliters nga solution, ang volume percent mao ang 45 percent.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Two Voyager probes were launched into space
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card states that two Voyager probes were launched into space. This is about man-made spacecraft, not the general structure of the solar system, major celestial objects, their features, or composition. It does not support the competency.

copy.en: Two Voyager probes were launched into space: the amazing Voyager 1 and the Voyager 2!
copy.tl: Dalawang Voyager probe ang inilunsad sa kalawakan: ang Voyager 1 at ang Voyager 2!
copy.bis: Duha ka Voyager probe ang gilunsad sa kalawakan: ang Voyager 1 ug ang Voyager 2!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wait for instructions from authorities before returning home after a volcanic eruption.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify and describe some of the materials formed during volcanic eruptions in the Philippines
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about post-eruption safety instructions, not about identifying or describing materials formed during volcanic eruptions. No overlap with the competency's content.

copy.en: Wait for instructions from authorities before returning home after a volcanic eruption.
copy.tl: Hintayin ang mga panuto mula sa mga awtoridad bago bumalik sa bahay pagkatapos ng pagsabog ng bulkan.
copy.bis: Hulata ang mga instruksyon gikan sa mga awtoridad sa dili pa mobalik sa balay human sa pag-ulbo sa bulkan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Cross only when the 'Walk' or walking man sign turns green!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: using flow charts and labeled diagrams explain the role of plants and animals in the cycles of nature, such as the carbon, oxygen, and water cycles
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches pedestrian road-crossing safety (traffic walk sign), which has no connection to the role of plants and animals in carbon, oxygen, or water cycles. It does not support any part of the competency.

copy.en:
When should you cross the road at an intersection?

Cross only when the 'Walk' or walking man sign turns green!
copy.tl:
Kailan ka dapat tumawid sa kalsada sa isang intersection?

Tumawid lamang kapag ang 'Walk' o walking man sign ay naging berde!
copy.bis:
Kanus-a ka angay motabok sa dalan sa usa ka intersection?

Tabok lamang kon ang 'Walk' o walking man sign mahimong berde!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It can be converted into a sink
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses repairing/reusing an old washing machine as a sink. It does not describe chemical properties such as burning, reacting, or biodegradability, so it does not support G4-M-3.

copy.en:
Can an old washing machine still be useful?

Yes! It can be converted into a sink, which is Repair, fixing or restoring broken items to be used again.
copy.tl:
Maaari pa bang maging kapaki-pakinabang ang lumang washing machine?

Oo! Maaari itong gawing lababo, na Repair, ang pagkukumpuni o pagpapanumbalik ng mga sirang bagay para magamit muli.
copy.bis:
Mahimo pa bang mapuslanon ang daan nga washing machine?

Oo! Mahimo kining himoong lababo, nga Repair, ang pag-ayo o pagpabalik sa mga guba nga butang aron magamit pag-usab.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: How often is garbage collected in many Philippine communities?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how the subduction of an oceanic plate impacts on the plate above it
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about garbage collection frequency in Philippine communities, which is unrelated to the competency on subduction of an oceanic plate and its impact on the overlying plate. No plate tectonics content is present.

copy.en:
How often is garbage collected in many Philippine communities?

In the study, twice daily except Sundays, and household members brought their garbage when the truck arrived.
copy.tl:
Gaano kadalas kinokolekta ang basura sa maraming komunidad sa Pilipinas?

Sa pag-aaral, dalawang beses araw-araw maliban sa Linggo, at dinadala ng mga miyembro ng sambahayan ang kanilang basura pagdating ng trak.
copy.bis:
Kanus-a kanunay kolektahon ang basura sa daghang komunidad sa Pilipinas?

Sa pagtuon, kaduha kada adlaw gawas sa Domingo, ug gidala sa mga miyembro sa panimalay ang ilang basura pag-abot sa trak.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Stepping on organisms and their habitat can damage an intertidal zone.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the changes in the direction and length of shadows from a shadow stick and use the information to infer why the Sun changes position during a day
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses human impact on intertidal zones, which is unrelated to the competency about shadow stick observations and inferring the Sun's position changes during the day.

copy.en: Stepping on organisms and their habitat can damage an intertidal zone.
copy.tl: Ang pagtapak sa mga organismo at sa kanilang habitat ay maaaring makasira sa intertidal zone.
copy.bis: Ang pagtamak sa mga organismo ug sa ilang habitat makadaot sa intertidal zone.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water is a cheap and good insulator lubricant that helps keep the engine from overheating during long drives.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: discuss as a class how threats to biodiversity can lead to species extinction
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses water used to cool jeepney engines; it has no content about biodiversity, threats to biodiversity, or species extinction, which are the focus of G9-L-7.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Water is a cheap and good insulator lubricant that helps keep the engine from overheating during long drives.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe the possible effects of human activities, such as deforestation, pollution, and introduction of invasive species, on living things in an ecosystem
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about engine cooling and water's properties, not about human activities such as deforestation, pollution, or invasive species and their effects on living things in an ecosystem.

copy.en:
Why do jeepney drivers put water in their engines?

Water is a cheap and good insulator lubricant that helps keep the engine from overheating during long drives.
copy.tl:
Bakit nilalagyan ng tubig ang makina ng jeepney?

Ang tubig ay mura at magandang insulator lubricant na tumutulong para hindi mag-overheat ang makina sa mahabang biyahe.
copy.bis:
Ngano butangan man ug tubig ang makina sa jeepney?

Ang tubig kay barato ug maayo nga insulator lubricant nga makatabang aron dili mag-overheat ang makina sa taas nga biyahe.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A liquid flows into all the corners and edges, taking the exact shape of its container.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify practical applications of electromagnetic radiation, such as radio waves used in telecommunications, and x-rays and gamma rays in medicine
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes liquid taking the shape of its container, a matter/state-of-matter concept. G9-F-12 requires identifying practical applications of electromagnetic radiation (radio waves, x-rays, gamma rays), which is entirely unrelated.

copy.en:
Does water fill the corners and edges of a container?

Yes! A liquid flows into all the corners and edges, taking the exact shape of its container.
copy.tl:
Napupuno ba ng tubig ang mga sulok at gilid ng lalagyan?

Oo! Ang liquid ay dumadaloy sa lahat ng sulok at gilid, at eksaktong sinusunod ang hugis ng lalagyan nito.
copy.bis:
Mapuno ba sa tubig ang mga suok ug kilid sa sudlanan?

Oo! Ang liquid moagos sa tanang suok ug kilid, ug eksaktong nagsunod sa porma sa sudlanan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During the light-dependent reactions, water molecules are split to provide free electrons and release oxygen gas into the air.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe homeostasis as a state of balance among all the body systems in humans that needs to be maintained for survival and proper functioning; its indicators include body temperature, glucose level, and blood pressure
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes water splitting in photosynthesis, a process in plant cells. G10-L-1 requires describing homeostasis as a state of balance among human body systems with indicators like body temperature, glucose level, and blood pressure. The card provides no information about homeostasis or human body systems.

copy.en: During the light-dependent reactions, water molecules are split to provide free electrons and release oxygen gas into the air.

copy.en: Each wrist, or carpal, consists of 8 bones, while the palm, or metacarpal, has 5 bones.
copy.tl: Ang bawat wrist, o carpal, ay may 8 buto, habang ang palad, o metacarpal, ay may 5 buto.
copy.bis: Ang matag wrist, o carpal, adunay 8 ka bukog, samtang ang palad, o metacarpal, adunay 5 ka bukog.
